workflow.critical: Communicate in {communication_language}. Test-case text in {document_output_language}. Markdown only — no XLSX, no generated spec files.

step.action: If config worktree_isolation is not false: follow Phase A of {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/rules/worktree-isolation.md — create a FRESH branch + git worktree every time (never reuse an old one), work only inside it (no port change needed). Whole command runs inside it
Confirm {output_folder}/EXECUTION-GUIDE.md exists and has no TODO values; else tell the user to run /aiqa-setup and stop
Story file(s) = command arguments; if none, ask. Several files of one feature → one story folder named after the first
Load and follow {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/reusable-prompts/write-test-cases.prompt.md with {{story_file}} = the story path
Write each file to disk as soon as it is complete
Run the "Review checklist" in write-test-cases.prompt.md over every file written; fix each issue in the file; re-check. Max 2 rounds
step.check: Every AC has at least one case; every guide role touching the screen has an RBAC case
Texts, ids, routes come from code/story/DB; gaps table filled; INDEX.md updated

step.output: File list + case counts + review result (issues found / fixed / open). Then the final line (Next Step is : <next command>).

step.action: After the review pass: follow Phase B (stop app, reset port to the base value, verify, commit on the sub-branch) and Phase C of {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/rules/worktree-isolation.md. Ask the user to commit/push/merge to the base branch and remove the sub-branch; never do it unasked
step.output: The LAST line of the response is: (Next Step is : <next command>) — see "Next-step line" in the rule file. Nothing after it
